name: NQ-Open
description: Natural Questions Open is an open-domain question answering benchmark derived from the Natural Questions dataset. Questions come from real Google search queries and require models to retrieve and answer from Wikipedia. The open-domain setting requires no provided context, forcing retrieval-augmented or parametric knowledge-based answering with short answers.
reputation: Standard open-domain QA benchmark; widely used to evaluate retrieval-augmented generation and parametric knowledge; DPR and RAG papers used this benchmark
notes: Original Natural Questions published at TACL 2019. NQ-Open format (no passage context) popularized by Lee et al. (2019) for open-domain QA evaluation. Contains 87,925 training examples with long + short answer annotations, 7,830 dev examples. The open-domain version uses only questions with short answers. Fundamental benchmark for RAG and dense retrieval research. Note: natural_questions.json exists but may differ in scope.
